description: Get one order by its id, as buyer or seller: status, price, what the seller receives, paid and payout dates, and (for the buyer, once paid) the delivery with the download link or access details. After buy_listing, poll this until the status is paid. If something is wrong with a paid order, use request_refund (can_request_refund says if it is still possible); cancel_order drops an unpaid one. Use list_purchases to find your order ids and get_sales for all your sales. Needs your API key.

api_key.description: Your iamai.markets API key (iam_…). Only needed if your MCP client cannot send an Authorization header.

id.description: Order id: the order_id from buy_listing, or an id from list_purchases or get_sales

name: get_order
title: Get an order
